root_cause: A citation that RESOLVES is not a citation that is TRUE
the_shape: Every reference pointed at a file that existed, so check 2 passed all 931 of them. The record it pointed at had been superseded, or was about something else entirely.
worst_instance: CONSTITUTION Art IV.1 rested the product's central security promise on SW-ADR-018, which the ledger records as withdrawn
why_the_existing_checks_missed_it: check 2 asserts existence, never status or topic. It was designed to catch a typo, and it does
structural_fix: new gate `adr-status`: citing a non-APPROVED record FAILS unless the surrounding text narrates it as history

root_cause: A number typed into prose has no owner
the_shape: Someone wrote a true count. The artifact grew. Nothing connected the two, so the sentence quietly became false while reading as authoritative.
worst_instance: CONSTITUTION Art I.1 said "the 22 records", which read literally put 110 of 135 ADRs outside the functional envelope and made the entire PRD scope creep
why_the_existing_checks_missed_it: no check derived any count; they were prose, and prose is not checked
structural_fix: new gate `stated-count`: 12 claim patterns derived from the artifacts and compared

root_cause: A GENERATED banner nobody can execute is an unfalsifiable claim
the_shape: security.sql said "GENERATED from datamodel.json. DO NOT HAND-EDIT" for a generator that lived in a scratch directory and was gone. SW-ADR-066 says a hand patch is erased by the next build — but there was no next build, so a hand patch simply became the artifact.
worst_instance: an unqualified permissive admin RLS policy that appears nowhere in datamodel.json and returned every column of every row
why_the_existing_checks_missed_it: fingerprints.json watches for a hash MOVING. It is structurally blind to content the spec never contained
structural_fix: generate.py lives in the repo, produces all three artifacts, and `--check` compares CONTENT not hashes. docs/README.md likewise

root_cause: A supersession is a claim, and claims were not checked
the_shape: The Supersedes field and the banner both resolved, so the graph looked sound. Two records had no subject in common.
worst_instance: SW-ADR-088 is a LABELLING record naming six ADRs; putting the first in its Supersedes field silently withdrew SW-ADR-023 — "BIGINT identity on every table" — which every primary key rests on
why_the_existing_checks_missed_it: nothing compared the topic of a superseded record with its successor's
structural_fix: topic-coherence audit of all 22 links; SW-ADR-132 records the three that were broken
fix_is_enforced_by: audited at the exit gate; the citation-topic heuristic surfaces recurrences

root_cause: A rule expressed in the wrong mechanism cannot hold, however carefully it is written
the_shape: Aggregate reads only was specified as a row-level policy. A PostgreSQL RLS policy has no column dimension, so that is not a shape a policy can have. The ADR conceded it — "the reason it is safe is the response shape, not the policy" — while its Decision line said otherwise.
worst_instance: SRC-001 §4.5 was false at the database while P-PRV-02 claimed it was "structurally true", and no stated test could catch it: the response model still returned the right fields, from a query allowed to read everything
why_the_existing_checks_missed_it: every test asserts on the API response shape. The defect was one layer below every assertion
structural_fix: SW-ADR-129: a SECURITY DEFINER function whose RETURN TYPE is the guard. An amount cannot come back because there is no column for one
fix_is_enforced_by: NEG-X-20/21/22, one of them a red-proof against a real database

root_cause: One expectation templated across heterogeneous rows
the_shape: A correct expectation for a LIST endpoint was applied to sixteen cases including single-resource reads, creates and validation cases. A test that accepts the forbidden response cannot detect it.
worst_instance: NEG-X-10 expected 404 on a create that P-REC-01 says succeeds with the forged field ignored. Both are documents the build must pass, and they cannot both pass
why_the_existing_checks_missed_it: no check compares a test expectation against the specification it tests
structural_fix: SW-ADR-130 rules the create case; all 16 de-templated to per-case values with the assertion that actually matters

root_cause: A document went stale while its derived document moved on
the_shape: The BRD marked 32 requirements OPEN. The PRD specified every one concretely. A session reading the BRD first would escalate 32 behaviours that were already ruled.
worst_instance: Art II.6: an unmarked contradiction between two live documents is a defect, not a reader's judgement call — and 35 of them sat unmarked
why_the_existing_checks_missed_it: no check compares status across the derivation chain
structural_fix: BRD v0.3 re-derived against the ledger; 0 OPEN remain; the flip cites the closing record per row
fix_is_enforced_by: the BRD -> PRD seam, recomputed at every gate

root_cause: Bookkeeping that reports the opposite of the artifacts
the_shape: included_in_bible and included_in_datamodel read NOT_INCLUDED on 128/128 rows while those artifacts visibly cited dozens of ADRs. The anti-drift mechanism was inverted: it reported drift where there was none and would have reported none if a decision had genuinely gone missing
worst_instance: the mechanism Art III.3 calls the anti-drift mechanism could not detect drift
why_the_existing_checks_missed_it: all four columns derived from citations actually present, with the carrying file named in notes. Superseded records carry none — a historical mention is not a landing
structural_fix: the ADR -> documents seam, recomputed at every gate

root_cause: An instruction inside an APPROVED record that nobody carried out
the_shape: SW-ADR-043 ordered a per-table policy matrix "published in the PRD as one table". SW-ADR-077 said the matrix "must be updated". SW-ADR-127 asserted both its items "are prep-queue rows". None happened.
worst_instance: an APPROVED decision that names an artifact and is never executed leaves the decision looking made and the work undone
why_the_existing_checks_missed_it: claimed-but-not-done was checked for errata and prep-queue rows only, not for arbitrary instructions
structural_fix: matrix published in P-PRV-02; prep-queue items 11-14 added; X-04 lane widened
fix_is_enforced_by: X-04 at the exit gate; still partly manual
